checks.name: Scope and unqualified external gates
checks.evidence: This disposition covers the seven retained milestone A UI checks and four retained required route/flows only. Full screen-reader/browserzoom/replay-motion conformance, LAN/loadp95, Windows, B/C, participant usability and educational effectiveness are outside this bounded gate; none is claimed. Fixture-model browser paths do not prove real-model adaptation. Separate real-model-current.json single-call proof was not rerun here. Full sandbox-frame axe did not complete in v1; this review uses targeted top-level contrast and explicit keyboard checks. Backend authorization/storage review remains separate.

findings.title: Narrow observer layout lacks the accepted screen/AI switch
findings.expected: The approved plan section2 requires narrow layouts to switch between trainee screen and AI activity.
findings.observed: The <=900px rule stacks both sections. At320px terminal review the AI activity starts at document y1483.5; the trainee screen is scaled to a296px card. The two buttons inside the first card switch tab/actions, not trainee/AI panes.
findings.consequence: The agreed narrow observation mode is absent; comparing screen with actual AI activity requires long page travel.
findings.reproduce: Open a fixture run with recorded tab and AI events; use320px width. Inspect both always-visible cards and the absence of a trainee/AI selector.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/styles/live.css:859,870; apps/web/src/features/live/ObserverView.tsx:139-144. Browser measured AI top1483.5 at320px,1389.8 at390px,1049.5 at768px. Screenshot terminal-320.
findings.remedy: Add an accessible narrow-screen trainee/AI view selector with selected state and one pane shown, retaining desktop split view and recording segment selection.
findings.retest: At320/390/768 widths, use keyboard to switch trainee/AI panes; verify focus, selected state and retained segment/scrub state. Retest1440 split view.
findings.resolution_evidence: At 320/390/768 px, Space/Enter switches accessible Trainee view/AI view buttons, aria-pressed follows selection, one pane is visible and the other display:none; segment1 remains selected after both switches. At1440 both panes visible. Current suite adds matching live-state keyboard checks.

findings.title: Terminal review promises a next model turn
findings.expected: Terminal review states that AI execution ended, preserving unavailable/stopped reasons where known.
findings.observed: The header says Recorded and lifecycle says aborted, while AI activity says Waiting for the next model turn.
findings.consequence: The review presents contradictory execution state and implies another turn will occur.
findings.reproduce: Open an aborted fixture run with thinking=false and ai_unavailable=false.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/features/live/ObserverView.tsx:141; current API snapshot terminalaborted. Actual rendered terminal1440 screenshot.
findings.remedy: Derive the AI status copy from terminal lifecycle before pending/generating/idle states; keep exact lifecycle/result visible.
findings.retest: Open completed/aborted/technical_failure reviews and live paused/thinking/unavailable states; verify no pending next-turn claim in terminal views.
findings.resolution_evidence: Actual aborted run now says Exercise ended. This is its recorded AI activity. and no next-turn promise. Browser presentation overrides, explicitly not actual engine outcomes, verified completed/technical_failure also ended, paused shows paused, generating shows generating, unavailable shows no substitute.

findings.title: Keyboard focus enters the inert recorded screen
findings.expected: The noninteractive replay display is skipped by keyboard; real review controls retain visible focus.
findings.observed: Sequential Tab enters the outer observer iframe after segment selection with no visible outline, and the next Tab reaches a recorded BUTTON inside the nested replay. pointer-events:none blocks the mouse, not this keyboard focus path.
findings.consequence: Keyboard users encounter an unmarked focus stop and historical controls that cannot operate the exercise, before reaching current review controls.
findings.reproduce: At1440px on a terminal run with a recorded screen, Tab from recording segment selector. Inspect document.activeElement and nested contentDocument.activeElement, then press Tab again.
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/features/live/ObserverView.tsx:77; apps/web/src/styles/live.css:864. Browser: outer IFRAME computed outline none; next Tab nested replay activeElement BUTTON.
findings.remedy: Remove outer/nested replay documents from sequential focus and make replay content inert; keep the labelled display available for review without fake historical interactive controls.
findings.retest: Tab/Shift+Tab through the entire observer page; replay DOM controls receive no focus, and slider/segment/details/invitations have visible focus.
findings.resolution_evidence: Tab from recording segment SELECT reaches actual range INPUT; Shift+Tab returns to SELECT. Full35-step keyboard traversal includes slider/details/invitation controls with2px orange outlines and no IFRAME. Outer frame inert=true,tabIndex=-1; replay root inert=true.
